data.question: The board reloads itself every 30 seconds, which wipes a half-typed model name. Pause the refresh while the Settings tab is open, or keep the page always-live and accept the loss?
data.recommendation: pause it while Settings is open — the other three tabs stay live, and an unsaved field is the only thing at risk
data.default: pause it while Settings is open

data.question: Should the board be able to WRITE at all? Once it can, 'read-only board on loopback' stops being true, and that sentence is currently load-bearing in the docs.
data.recommendation: yes, behind an explicit --write flag that is off by default
